name: Ise no Saburou Yoshimori
original_name: 伊勢 三郎 義盛
source:
A member of a group of thieves who attacked the protagonist on the way to Hiraizumi. However he changed his mind and ended up attacking his own men to help her.
He noticed then that the protagonist was a a noble son of the Genji family and stubbornly followed her.
He's usually a flashy and flirty person, but he has a crafty and eloquent side.
Uniquely because of his past as a thief, he shows talent as a strategist with his free thinking ideas.
